The '''Cyrillian Protectorate''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]] and [[Prazhi]].
